selected_script.angle: Clearing greasy spice jars from the top of the stove to prevent heat damage and splatters by mounting them on the side of the fridge
selected_script.hook: Stop lining your spices on top of the stove where they get greasy and overheated.

video_001_part_01.description: 0-3s: A close-up of a messy, greasy stovetop where a person reaches for a spice jar and accidentally knocks over another, spilling powder next to a hot pan. 3-6s: The camera cuts to a hand snapping a matte black rectangular metal magnetic rack onto the side of a clean white refrigerator near the stove. 6-10s: The hand neatly places three spice jars onto the rack, showing them sitting securely behind the front retaining wall.

video_001_part_02.description: 0-4s: A close-up showing the detachable metal hooks being hooked onto the bottom edge of the matte black rack, with a pair of silicone oven gloves being hung from them. 4-8s: A wider shot of the refrigerator side showing two racks mounted vertically, holding oils, spices, and hanging tools neatly. 8-10s: A clean visual with a text overlay: 'Upgrade your kitchen setup today.' no hard-sell voiceover.
